name: Teleportal
summary: The Teleportal is an interactive map and gateway that allows users to explore, find, and experience virtual world platforms through the research and curation of the Virtual Worlds Museum™. It transforms years of documentation into a navigable experience, presenting virtual worlds as part of a connected ecosystem rather than isolated destinations.
